text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day.
While many Umamusume are feeling restless and excited, as for Curren Chan—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Hello to everyone on Umastagram,
it's Curren Chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I'd get some pose requests from everyone today,
so I'm streaming right now~"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because today is Valentine's Day!
I can't give you chocolates, though, so..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Here's a cute photo of Curren
as a present for everyone♪”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"‘Applying is easy!
In the following post—’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan devotes herself entirely to fan service.
Just as I wondered if she'd keep this up all day—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro~ther.
Today is Valentine's Day♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis~.
Today is Valentine's Day♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren followed a recipe and made chocolates too♪
I think they look absolutely perfect!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right~♪
I wonder who the lucky person will be~...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our gazes lock.
With that meaningful look in their eyes, I went to ask who it was for, but..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, maybe that's enough
talk about Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we start training?
I look forward to working with you today, too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, even during training breaks—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
With the chocolates, you see, I first had my roommate
Ayabe-san taste-test them~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san can be so mean, you know?
She told me it tasted terrible.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You see, I wanted to add some edible flower arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So I took the chrysanthemum from the sashimi
and put it in, but~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Looks like the flavor wasn't quite right after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"They got mad at me and said,
'Don't experiment on me!'♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry, I looked at the recipe properly
and remade it after that, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, break time's over~♪
I'm gonna go for a light run~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Valentine's Day came up in conversation a few times, but not a word was said about what to do with the chocolates that had been prepared...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Phew~, I worked hard today too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's call it a day.
Good work, everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who were those chocolates for?
I was curious, but given my position,
I couldn't just casually bring it up...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, Curren's taking off now.
Bye-byee♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After finishing up training.
I had an errand to run outside,
and while I was out...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, Valentine's Day is already over, huh?
It was so much fun this year too.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's trade again next year♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Valentine's Day is already over.
Nothing special happened this year either.
Just as I was thinking that—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting for you, Big Brother.
Because...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting for you, Big Sis.
Because...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because I hadn't taken care of
an important errand yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Big Brother!
Happy Valentine's♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Big Sister!
Happy Valentine's♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You look relieved, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You look relieved, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Were you worried~... that you might not get one, with your heart pounding?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, did I hit the bullseye?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You were so restless, Big Brother,
it was super cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You were so restless, Big Sister,
it was super cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You've been craving this chocolate for so long, so make sure to savor every bite, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed I had been dancing in the palm of Curren Chan's hand all along...
It turned out to be an unforgettable Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...What do you think
Curren's errand is?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan is smiling...
but somehow, I feel an undeniable pressure...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you know already, right?
Say it, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you know already, right?
Say it, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're really going to make Curren say it, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...You don't even want it, Onii-chan.
That's why you can stay so relaxed, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...You don't want it, do you, Sis?
That's why you can stay so calm, right?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I made it myself with all my heart, you know?
Curren, who normally doesn't cook, made it from scratch, carefully choosing all the ingredients...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Even though... only one person can eat it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you want it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, you finally said it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pressure radiating from Curren Chan vanished.
Apparently, she wanted me to ask for Valentine's chocolates myself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then here's Curren's ultimate, super-cute chocolate...
just for you, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then here's Curren's ultimate, super-cute chocolate...
just for you, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If you tell me you want it 100 more times♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You kept Curren waiting so long, after all.
You can do it, right, Onii-chan?âª

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You kept Curren waiting so long, after all.
You can do it, right, Onee-chan?âª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the chocolate I finally got after asking 101 times was...
Extraordinarily swee... sweet... way too sweet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I put in too much sugar?
Just think of it as Curren's extra love and forgive me, okay?♪
